channel.title: Farsçadan (English)
channel.description: AI-assisted English translations of selected stories from Iran's Persian-language press. Every story notes the outlet's political orientation.

item.title: Fidan sends clear message from Istanbul summit: New attack would widen war
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: At the R4+E3 summit in Istanbul, Fidan and European counterparts stated agreement that a new attack on Iran would widen the conflict in the region. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: US Ambassador to Ankara Barrack: Attack on Iran this weekend is possible
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: US Ambassador to Ankara Tom Barrack said an attack on Iran this coming weekend is "absolutely possible"; Trump's messaging has been contradictory. (Source: Khabaronline)

item.title: Oil price exceeds $117: Hormuz tensions and Trump's conflicting messages
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Oil prices climb above $117 amid Strait of Hormuz tensions and concerns over possible US military action against Iran; Trump signals are mixed. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Iran International: At least 79 executed in the month of Mehr
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to Iran International, the judiciary executed at least 79 people, including two women, on various charges during the month of Mehr. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Tehran Education Department selling 10 properties: Vanak land could finance 70 new schools
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Tehran Education Department prepares to sell 10 properties; a single parcel in Vanak Square could finance construction of 60-70 new schools. (Source: ISNA)

item.title: Seven nations' foreign ministers gather in Istanbul: Hormuz, Yemen, and Iran war on agenda
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Seven countries' foreign ministers met in Istanbul under Turkey's hosting to discuss Strait of Hormuz security and the Iran war. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Atlantic: Trump evaluates multi-day military strike on Iran after election
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: The Atlantic reports Trump administration is considering a multi-day military strike on Iran following U.S. midterm elections. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Explosions heard in Riyadh: Houthis continue strikes on Saudi Arabia
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Yemeni Houthis struck southern Saudi Arabia, loud explosions heard in Riyadh; cause remains unconfirmed. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: U.S. Treasury proposes investment restrictions on Iran, China, Russia and North Korea
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: U.S. Treasury Department proposed new rules restricting semiconductor and AI investments to Iran and four other countries. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Assembly member: Supreme Leader's wounds have healed; lack of appearance is security measure
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Assembly member says Leader Khamenei was previously wounded but has fully recovered; his public absence is a security precaution. (Source: Ettelaat)

item.title: Mecca Defense Pact submitted to Parliament, Turkey expands defense network
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Turkey submitted the Mecca Pact with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan to Parliament; separate defense industry deals signed with Qatar and Pakistan. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: US orders evacuation of embassy personnel from Saudi Arabia
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to AFP, the US ordered evacuation of embassy personnel and families from Saudi Arabia; Reuters reported broader preparations underway in the Gulf. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: US Treasury sanctions 18 targets tied to Iran's 'shadow fleet'
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: US Treasury sanctioned 5 individuals, 4 companies, and 9 vessels involved in facilitating Iran's oil smuggling and sanctions evasion. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Drone attack on Safaniyah oil field: 2 killed, Saudi Arabia strikes Yemen
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Saudi Arabia's Energy Ministry reported a drone attack on the Aramco-operated Safaniyah oil field killed 2 workers and wounded 2 others. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: 38 women and children killed in 28 femicide cases in Iran over two months
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to data compiled by the reformist Shargh newspaper, 28 femicide cases in Iran over two months resulted in at least 38 women and children deaths. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: New defense minister approved by Parliament with 237 votes: "We are ready for the 4th war"
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Ahlaki approved as defense minister with 237 votes; said they are ready for a "4th war" scenario against Israel. (Source: Kayhan)

item.title: Araghchi replies to Netanyahu: 'We have unfinished business too'
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Netanyahu said Iran will recover; Foreign Minister Araghchi replied, "We have unfinished business," hinting at unresolved confrontation. (Source: ISNA)

item.title: Rubio sided with Britain on Iran's role in RAF Fairford attack plan
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Washington agrees with Britain's assessment of Iran's role in the Fairford airbase attack plan. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Turkey's Energy Minister: Turkey will also get a share of Russia-U.S. gasoil deal
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Turkey's Energy Minister Bayraktar said Turkey will also receive a share of the Russia-U.S. gasoil agreement; deal details remain unverified. (Source: ISNA (from Channel 7 interview, via Donya-ye Eqtesad))

item.title: Macron linked fuel price hikes to the Iran war, street violence continues in France
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Macron said France's fuel price increases come from the U.S.-Iran war; looting continues, opposition calls for his resignation. (Source: Ettelaat)
